steps.label: unpack
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && [ "$(md5 -q fe/fe_bundle.tgz)" = 73e4de1a0b1913ffd67356ac9d5fe1d0 ] && [ "$(md5 -q fe/fe_mix.m4a)" = 22ec5aabd9188d7a2deb460c04b93978 ] && rm -rf fe/bundle && mkdir -p fe/bundle && tar xzf fe/fe_bundle.tgz -C fe/bundle && for f in fe/bundle/*.js; do [ -f "$f.map" ] || echo '{"version":3,"sources":[],"names":[],"mappings":""}' > "$f.map"; done; ls fe/bundle/public | wc -l

steps.label: render
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && npx remotion render fe/bundle P fe_out.mp4 --gl=angle --crf=18 --muted --concurrency=6 --timeout=180000 --log=error

steps.label: mux
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && npx remotion ffmpeg -y -v error -i fe_out.mp4 -i fe/fe_mix.m4a -map 0:v -map 1:a -c copy -shortest fe_film.mp4 && npx remotion ffmpeg -y -v error -i fe_film.mp4 -vf scale=1280:720 -c:v libx264 -preset veryfast -crf 27 -c:a aac -b:a 128k fe_720.mp4 && ls -l fe_film.mp4 fe_720.mp4 > fe_done.txt; cat fe_done.txt
